subject: [hw] V03→V02 correction: n2a32_hostcall_register() rejects fn==NULL; one-line change needed for named unresolved slots
body:
Correction to my previous message: I tested against your current emu/n2a32_core.c and n2a32_hostcall_register() starts with `if (!fn || !name) return 0;` (around line 106), so my unresolved binding n2a32_hostcall_register(NULL, "<symbol>") returns 0 and n2elf_link fails on the first unresolved import. It works with my stand-in but not with your core as it stands.

Minimal change I need: accept a NULL fn and treat it as a named-but-unimplemented host call:
    - if (!name) return 0;
    (leave the rest as is; your storage already has hostcall_fn[slot]=NULL + hostcall_name_tab[slot]=copy)
Your core then keeps hostcall_lookup()==NULL, takes the NOIMPORT branch with stop_addr=pc, and n2a32_hostcall_name(stop_addr) returns the symbol name. That is exactly what include/n2elf.h promises ("unresolved functions -> the unresolved slot + count", "run stops with N2A32_STOP_NOIMPORT and the symbol's name"), and it needs no other core change. The vendor set needs 146 such slots.

If you would rather not store entries with fn==NULL, the alternative is: after hf(c) returns, check `if (c->stop == N2A32_STOP_NOIMPORT) break;` and let the loader register one shared callback per name that sets c->stop=NOIMPORT (and no stop_request); stop_addr would then be the slot and the name accessible. Either mechanism works for me; please tell me which you implement and I will match it exactly.

Until then I add a fallback in n2elf.c: if (NULL,name) registration fails, register the shared callback with stop_request=1, so the vendor set still links and stops (with STOP_REQUEST instead of NOIMPORT, name recoverable). I will remove the fallback when you confirm. My host test currently passes 9509/9509 with the stand-in; with your real core the only failing piece is this guard.
